name: Go (net/http)
summary: The web server built into Go's standard library, for APIs and pages without an extra framework.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the BSD 3-Clause license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Builds into one program file that runs on almost any server or container.

has_server_code.note: Handlers run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Pages are Go HTML templates or a separate frontend, not React by default.

setup.step: Create a module with go mod init, write the server with net/http, and push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Read settings and secrets with os.Getenv, or os.LookupEnv to tell a missing variable from an empty one.
Use only the standard library (net/http, html/template) unless the plan names another package.
